scope: Eight original published-head findings plus independently reproduced repair follow-ups; all resolved in local fixture scope

initial_finding.title: An old state command retry can reactivate a later paused goal
initial_finding.trigger: An active transition commits and its response is lost; a later authorized pause commits; the earlier caller retransmits the same active request.
initial_finding.invariant_broken: Blueprint GoalService.transition expected revision and common mutable-pointer compare-and-set/idempotent command ordering. A retry must not supply renewed authority or reverse a newer pause.
initial_finding.reproduction: Real PostgreSQL on an exclusively named disposable database migrated to published HEAD: paused -> active (lost response) -> paused -> duplicate active. Final state is active and goal revision remains unchanged. Existing public DTO accepts state alone.
initial_finding.repair_requirement: Require exact current goal revision plus a monotonic state revision, actor/input-bound immutable command key/receipt, atomic projection/event/receipt writes, SQL transition guard, and API/SDK/CLI parity. Exact receipt retry returns its historic result; competing stale commands conflict.

initial_finding.title: Unsupported canonical context schemas inherit legacy authorization
initial_finding.trigger: A stored context payload uses an unknown or missing schema version while retaining common fixture-only fields and a current baseline reference.
initial_finding.invariant_broken: Unknown schema cannot be treated as compatible authoritative immutable context; missing typed authority/identity/deadline data must hold execution.
initial_finding.reproduction: Actual PostgreSQL accepts a RunContext.local.v99 canonical context and cycle/outbox. CycleOutbox.consume returns recorded rather than held. A pure probe also returns True for {}, local.v99 and GoalSpec.local.v2 without any current-authority read.
initial_finding.limits: No public DTO bypass demonstrated. Normal goal/admission code generates recognized typed contexts. Reproduction requires malformed/unsupported canonical row insertion, a privilege already needed by fixture application roles, or a future unqualified writer. Production is disabled.
initial_finding.repair_requirement: Explicitly identify supported legacy payload versions, validate recognized typed V2/V3 contexts fail closed, and reject unknown/missing/malformed schemas. Preserve genuine V1 compatibility: historical context column is RunContext.local.v1 but payload schema_version is GoalSpec.local.v1.

initial_finding.title: Accepted V3 cutover payload terminates poller and cannot roll back
initial_finding.trigger: A GoalSpec.local.v3 cutover reaches poll_once or rollback. V3 subclasses V2, so cadence._policy_goal accepts it and prepare/activate persist it.
initial_finding.invariant: Every accepted goal version must remain operable through automatic cadence and preservation-safe rollback.
initial_finding.reproduction: test_accepted_v3_schedule_can_auto_poll_and_rollback[poll|rollback] creates actual V3 goal/budget and accepts prepare/activate. Both fail with schema_version literal_error and allocation extra_forbidden. ValidationError also escapes run_until_stopped and its TaskGroup.
initial_finding.repair: Use canonical parse_goal and enforce V2 family, preserving V3 allocation. Contain per-goal invalid rows so one row cannot terminate the worker.

initial_finding.title: LIMIT before due selection indefinitely starves later active goals
initial_finding.trigger: Earliest batch_size active cutovers are idle, stopped or revoked while a later cutover is due.
initial_finding.invariant: Bounded independent cadence must eventually consider every eligible active goal.
initial_finding.reproduction: test_bounded_poller_eventually_considers_goal_after_idle_or_held_window[idle|stopped|revoked] has two active same-workspace cutovers and batch_size=1. Three polls never admit the second goal.
initial_finding.repair: Use bounded fair keyset scanning with advancement even for idle/held entries and wrap-around, or due-aware SQL plus fairness for poison/held goals. Test finite sweep bound.

initial_finding.title: Stop committed after rollback precheck does not block legacy resume
initial_finding.trigger: Workspace or goal stop commits after rollback authorization transaction closes but before FixtureLegacyScheduleControl.resume_after mutates job_schedules.
initial_finding.invariant: A committed current stop must deny new local legacy resume authority.
initial_finding.reproduction: test_stop_committed_at_legacy_resume_boundary_keeps_schedule_paused[workspace|goal] hooks resume_after, commits set_stop, then invokes the real DB resume. Both return rolled_back without PermissionError and activate the stopped schedule.
initial_finding.repair: Perform authority/goal/stop/unsafe-work checks and fixture resume atomically under canonical locks in its own mutation transaction. Preserve separate scoped remote boundary requirements for future Temporal control.

initial_finding.title: Exact archive replay recomputes and changes committed disposition
initial_finding.trigger: A reviewed/resumed intent expires before admission, its resolved case is terminalized and archived as expired, then late admission writes denied.
initial_finding.invariant: An exact archive retry returns the immutable result originally committed.
initial_finding.reproduction: test_archive_replay_keeps_original_expired_disposition_after_late_denial passes all real commands through first archive, then replay differs only disposition expired→denied.
initial_finding.repair: Replay immutable archived event/receipt disposition, or persist it in an additive archive receipt; never infer retry output from mutable/latest admission.

initial_finding.title: Transport acknowledgment permanently strands a terminal failed cycle workflow
initial_finding.trigger: Temporal accepts start, then fixture_runtime_binding exhausts its three bounded activity attempts (e.g. transient database outage); failed runtime later has healthy worker restart.
initial_finding.invariant: Acknowledged handoff without canonical inbox cannot disappear from durable recovery after runtime failure; preserve cycle/context/operation and owned bounded disposition.
initial_finding.actual: Actual Temporal WorkflowFailureError after three OperationalError attempts; worker restart and dispatch return leave outbox delivered, cycle runnable, inbox0, holds0, cases0, deadletters0.
initial_finding.fix_requirement: Reconcile terminal cycle runtime failures into durable same-identity owned hold/case/dead-letter, or defer final consumption acknowledgment with safe failure reconciliation. Retain historical deliveries and never start duplicate logical operation. Test failure before binding/consume and after signal; current fixtures and replay remain compatible.
initial_finding.status: REPAIRED; independently re-reviewed final worktree source and regression verified
initial_finding.rereview_requirement: Bind final commit to recorded source hashes and applicable full regression before checkpoint; no PR or production approval

initial_finding.title: Restricted scoped consumer commits an immutable receipt into a foreign cycle stream
initial_finding.trigger: Restricted NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS writer creates outbox with workspace/subject/goal/intent A and existing cycle B sequence2; foreign sequence1 already consumed; genuine CycleOutbox(workspace A).consume processes it.
initial_finding.invariant: Blueprint 4.5 requires database constraints plus service same-parent scope binding; UUID existence does not establish tenant/goal scope. Local P1b states consumer checks canonical scope. Foreign cycle stream/audit must receive no receipt from A.
initial_finding.actual: Independent FK checks accept mismatched outbox; consumer joins cycle only by id, returns held and commits one immutable inbox row into B and fixture_consumed event. Effect authority denies but canonical foreign receipt/audit is corrupted. Role explicitly cannot mutate identity_subjects/grants.
initial_finding.fix_requirement: Add same workspace/subject/goal/intent/cycle parent guard for outbox, matching inbox and event parent checks, plus defensive consumer binding before receipt. Apply additive migration with lock/preflight and hold corrupt existing history without rewriting; preserve downgrade guards.
initial_finding.status: REPAIRED; independently re-reviewed final worktree source and regression verified
initial_finding.rereview_requirement: Bind final commit to recorded source hashes and applicable full regression before checkpoint; no PR or production approval

repair_followups.trigger: cycles:write deny or program pause committed at actual resume boundary
repair_followups.fix: Actual mutation now checks scheduler._policy_goal/current write/program under locks.

repair_followups.trigger: write or schedule grant expires during actual resume transaction lock delay
repair_followups.fix: Both grants rechecked after legacy write, aborting transaction on expiry.

repair_followups.scope: New candidate 0033 migration hardening; absent from original published HEAD
repair_followups.trigger: No-op state receipt writer commits after history preflight under goals-only lock
repair_followups.red: Private-PG manual command committed under old lock; actual migration regression negative control rejects injected original weaker lock without DDL.
repair_followups.fix: Downgrade locks v4_goals and v4_goal_state_commands across preflight/DDL. Actual writer blocks until guard refuses downgrade, then commits receipt intact.

Ordinary dispatch polling revisits all-delivered held cycle with outstanding receipt after temporary message lock; no new command required.
